training_time_estimates.cnn_vae_model: Approximately 4.5 - 5.5 minutes (25 epochs over 40,000 samples @ batch size 64)
training_time_estimates.gnn_vae_model: Approximately 5 - 6 minutes (25 epochs over 40,000 graph samples @ batch size 64)
training_time_estimates.hybrid_vae_model: Approximately 4 - 5 minutes (20 epochs over 40,000 merged samples @ batch size 64). Faster per-epoch iteration since the base structural encoder layers evaluated in forward-mode are strictly frozen.
training_time_estimates.property_predictor_mlp: Under 1 minute (12 epochs mapping fixed 128D latent spaces).

non_deterministic_components_and_limitat.random_seed_initialization: No explicit global `torch.manual_seed()` overrides were enforced over Python, NumPy, or PyTorch RNG environments. Model initialization weights will vary strictly across runs.
non_deterministic_components_and_limitat.stochastic_latent_sampling: The operational `reparameterize(mu, logvar)` function inside the VAE block intrinsically relies on random Gaussian noise iterations (`torch.randn_like()`).
non_deterministic_components_and_limitat.dataloader_stochasticity: The dataset is repeatedly presented with `shuffle=True` using standard operational multithreading random sampling, causing varied minibatch distributions globally across runs.
non_deterministic_components_and_limitat.cudnn_benchmarking: `torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic` has not been strictly locked to True. Execution sequences via CuDNN on local GPUs may employ internal heuristic auto-tuning favoring speed over strict mathematical equivalence across repetitions.
